info.title: Rikkaus Wealth OS API
info.description: Versioned REST contract for the Rikkaus Wealth OS backend. Errors follow RFC 9457 with a urn:rikkaus:problem: type.

servers.description: Relative to the deployment's own base URL

get.summary: Read the reporting currency and the declared USD/VND rate
get.description: Returns VND as the fixed reporting currency together with the rate the user declared, the date they declared it effective, and when the server stored that declaration. The three rate fields are null until a rate has been declared; that is the rate-needed state, not an error.

200.description: The settings of the signed-in user

401.description: No access token, or it has expired or been revoked

406.description: The requested media type cannot be produced

put.description: Stores the rate and the date the user says it took effect, and stamps the server's own record of when it was stored. The effective date must not be in the future; it is judged as a Vietnamese civil date, not a UTC one.

400.description: The rate is missing or not positive, or the effective date is missing or in the future

errors.message: must not be in the future

401.description: No access token, or it has expired or been revoked

415.description: The request body is not JSON

get.description: Returns the signed-in user's identifier, their verified Google email, and the display name they chose — or the Google one if they never changed it.

200.description: The profile of the signed-in user

401.description: No access token, or it has expired or been revoked

406.description: The requested media type cannot be produced

put.description: Stores the name the user chose. It is kept apart from the name Google reports, so a later sign-in refreshes the Google value without reverting this one. The email is not editable: it comes from the verified identity token.

400.description: The display name is blank or longer than 120 characters

401.description: No access token, or it has expired or been revoked

415.description: The request body is not JSON

get.description: Returns the asset when the signed-in user owns it. An identifier belonging to another user answers not-found with the same body a missing identifier produces, so the response cannot be used to discover which identifiers exist.

400.description: The identifier in the path is not a UUID

401.description: No access token, or it has expired or been revoked

404.description: No such asset, or it belongs to another user

406.description: The requested media type cannot be produced

put.description: Replaces the name, liquidity, the optional common fields and the four instrument fields. An omitted optional field is cleared, because this is a replacement rather than a patch, which is how a ticker recorded by mistake is removed. The instrument fields are judged against the asset's stored category, because the category is not editable here. The current value, its currency, the valuation date and the category are not editable here: a new value belongs in the valuation history issue #57 introduces, and the category is chosen once when the asset is created.

200.description: The asset as it now stands

400.description: The name or liquidity is missing, a value is negative or too precise, a quantity is not positive, the purchase date is in the future or later than the asset's stored valuation date, or an instrument field was sent for an asset whose stored category does not accept it

401.description: No access token, or it has expired or been revoked

404.description: No such asset, it belongs to another user, or a concurrent request removed it first

406.description: The requested media type cannot be produced

415.description: The request body is not JSON

delete.description: Deletes the asset when the signed-in user owns it. This is the plain removal the generic destructive confirmation in the accepted design promises; undo, linked-record consequences and a retention policy belong to issue #102. A second delete of the same identifier answers not-found, so the response is not idempotent and that is deliberate: it is the same answer any unknown identifier gets. Two deletes that overlap, which is what a double-tapped confirm button produces, give one 204 and not-found to the rest rather than a server error.

400.description: The identifier in the path is not a UUID

401.description: No access token, or it has expired or been revoked

404.description: No such asset, it belongs to another user, or a concurrent request removed it first

post.description: Exchanges a refresh token for a new access token and a new refresh token. The presented token is single-use: presenting it again is treated as evidence that it leaked and revokes the whole session.

400.description: The refresh token is missing from the body

401.description: The refresh token is unknown, expired, already used, or revoked

415.description: The request body is not JSON

post.description: Revokes the session the refresh token belongs to. Returns 204 whether or not the token was still live, so the endpoint cannot be used to test whether a token is valid.

204.description: The session is no longer usable

400.description: The refresh token is missing from the body

415.description: The request body is not JSON

post.summary: Complete a Google sign-in and start a session
post.description: Exchanges an authorization code with Google using PKCE, creates the account on first sign-in, and returns an access token with a rotating refresh token. Google is the only identity provider; there is no password.

400.description: A field is missing, or the redirect URI is not allowlisted

errors.message: is not an allowed redirect URI

401.description: Google rejected the code, or the identity could not be verified

415.description: The request body is not JSON

get.description: Returns every asset the viewer owns, newest valuation date first and then by name, so the catalog's order is the server's rather than the database's incidental one. An empty catalog is an empty array and a 200, not a 404. Values are reported in each asset's own currency; converting a USD holding to VND is the client's, using the rate from GET /api/v1/settings/exchange-rate.

value.name: Tài khoản USD
value.notes: Tiền gửi dự phòng bằng USD.

401.description: No access token, or it has expired or been revoked

406.description: The requested media type cannot be produced

post.summary: Add an asset to the catalog
post.description: Creates an asset owned by the signed-in user. All prices are manually entered; there is no market-price integration in MVP 1A. The valuation date must not be in the future and a purchase date must not be later than it, both judged as Vietnamese civil dates. The four instrument fields are optional everywhere they are accepted, and sending none of them is valid for every category. A symbol, a cost per unit or a current price per unit is accepted only for LISTED_SECURITIES, BOND, INVESTMENT_FUND and OTHER_ASSET; an interest rate only for BOND, TERM_DEPOSIT and OTHER_ASSET. currentValue is never derived from a quantity and a unit price, and a request where their product differs from it is stored as sent.

a listed holding, with the instrument fi.description: 500 shares at 24150 a share. currentValue is 12000000.00, which is not 500 x 24150: it is the figure the user entered, and the server does not derive or check the product.

a term deposit, with a rate and nothing.description: The one instrument field a deposit accepts. A symbol or a unit price on this category is refused.

400.description: A required field is missing, a value is negative or too precise, a quantity is not positive, a date is impossible, or an instrument field was sent for a category that does not accept it. An unrecognised category, currency or liquidity is a malformed-request instead, because the body cannot be parsed.

instrument fields the category does not.description: A cash holding carrying a symbol and a unit price. Every refused field is named in one response rather than one per round trip.

must not be set for this asset category

purchase date after the valuation date.description: purchase date after the valuation date

errors.message: must not be later than the valuation date

get.summary: Report which build of the API the caller is talking to
get.description: Unauthenticated by design. Exposes the application name, the API version, the build version and the current server time in UTC, and nothing else. The build timestamp is deliberately withheld.

406.description: The requested media type cannot be produced

get.description: Confirms the access token is still valid and returns who it belongs to. This is how a client tells a live session from an expired or revoked one without having to infer it from a failed domain request.

401.description: No access token, or it has expired or been revoked

ProblemDetail.description: RFC 9457 problem details. Returned for every error under /api/v1/**.

type.description: Stable taxonomy identifier. A URN rather than a URL because the project owns no domain; RFC 9457 does not require it to dereference.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation, safe to display. Never contains a stack trace, an internal class name or a credential.

instance.description: The request URI the problem occurred for.

correlationId.description: Extension member. The same value as the X-Correlation-Id response header and the server's log lines for this request.

errors.description: Extension member, present on validation failures only. One entry per rejected field.

DeclareExchangeRateRequest.description: Declare the USD/VND exchange rate and the date it took effect.

usdToVndRate.description: How many VND one USD buys. Must be greater than zero.

effectiveDate.description: The date you confirm this rate took effect. Must not be in the future.

ExchangeRateResponse.description: The reporting currency and the user-declared USD/VND exchange rate.

baseCurrency.description: The reporting currency. Fixed to VND for MVP 1A.

usdToVndRate.description: How many VND one USD buys, as declared by the user. Null until declared.

effectiveDate.description: The date the user declares the rate took effect. Not the time it was stored.

updatedAt.description: When the server stored the declaration.

UpdateProfileRequest.description: Change the display name. The only editable profile field.

displayName.description: The name to show. Trimmed before storing.

email.description: From the verified Google identity token. Read-only here.

displayName.description: The name the user chose, or the Google name if they never chose one.

UpdateAssetMetadataRequest.description: Replace an asset's editable metadata. The valuation is not editable here.

name.description: What the user calls this asset.

liquidity.description: How readily the user judges this asset can be turned into cash.

purchaseValue.description: Purchase value or cost basis, in the asset's own currency. Omit to clear it.

purchaseDate.description: When the asset was acquired. Must not be in the future and must not be later than the asset's stored valuation date. Omit to clear it.

quantity.description: Units held. Must be greater than zero when present. Omit to clear it.

institution.description: Where the asset is held or stored. Omit to clear it.

notes.description: Anything the user wants to remember. Omit to clear it.
notes.example: Đã chuyển sang kỳ hạn 6 tháng.

symbol.description: Ticker, ISIN or fund code, as the user types it. Nothing resolves it against a market. Omit to clear it. Accepted for LISTED_SECURITIES, BOND, INVESTMENT_FUND and OTHER_ASSET; any other category refuses it.

costPerUnit.description: What one unit cost, in this asset's own currency. Entered by the user and never multiplied by the quantity. Accepted for the same four categories as the symbol.

currentPricePerUnit.description: What one unit is worth now, in this asset's own currency. Entered by the user; currentValue is a separate field and is never derived from this one. Accepted for the same four categories as the symbol.

interestRate.description: Interest rate or expected yield as a percent per year, so 6.2500 is 6.25%. No interest is accrued and no yield projected from it. Accepted for BOND, TERM_DEPOSIT and OTHER_ASSET only: a listed security has no rate, and a fund's expected return belongs in the notes.

name.description: What the user calls this asset.

category.description: One of the eleven asset categories.

currentValue.description: What the asset is worth, in its own currency.

currency.description: The currency the values are expressed in.

valuationDate.description: The date the user states the value was accurate.

liquidity.description: How readily the user judges it can be turned into cash.

purchaseValue.description: Purchase value or cost basis. Null when not recorded.

purchaseDate.description: When the asset was acquired. Null when not recorded.

quantity.description: Units held. Null when not recorded.

institution.description: Where it is held or stored. Null when not recorded.

notes.description: The user's own note. Null when not recorded.
notes.example: Tiền gửi dự phòng bằng USD.

symbol.description: Ticker, ISIN or fund code. Null when not recorded.

costPerUnit.description: What one unit cost. Null when not recorded.

currentPricePerUnit.description: What one unit is worth now. Null when not recorded. currentValue is not derived from it.

interestRate.description: Interest rate or expected yield as a percent per year, so 6.2500 is 6.25%. Null when not recorded.

createdAt.description: When the server first stored this asset.

updatedAt.description: When the server last stored a change to it.

RefreshSessionRequest.description: Carries the refresh token identifying the session to renew or end.

refreshToken.description: The refresh token returned by the most recent sign-in or renewal.

SessionResponse.description: A signed-in session: an access token, its lifetime, and the refresh token.

accessToken.description: Signed JWT to send as `Authorization: Bearer`.

expiresInSeconds.description: Seconds until the access token expires.

refreshToken.description: Single-use token for renewing the session. Rotated on every renewal.

GoogleSignInRequest.description: Completes a Google sign-in started by the client.

authorizationCode.description: The authorization code Google returned to the client's redirect URI.

codeVerifier.description: The PKCE code verifier for the challenge sent when the flow started.

redirectUri.description: The redirect URI used to obtain the code. Must appear in the server's allowlist.

CreateAssetRequest.description: Create an asset with the fields every category shares.

name.description: What the user calls this asset.

category.description: One of the eleven asset categories.

currentValue.description: What the asset is worth, in this asset's currency. Entered by the user; there is no price feed. Zero is allowed, negative is not.

currency.description: The currency the values are expressed in. The reporting currency is separately fixed to VND and is read from the settings resource.

valuationDate.description: The date the user states this value was accurate. Must not be in the future, judged as a Vietnamese civil date.

liquidity.description: How readily the user judges this asset can be turned into cash.

purchaseValue.description: Purchase value or cost basis, in the same currency.

purchaseDate.description: When the asset was acquired. Must not be in the future and must not be later than the valuation date.

quantity.description: Units held, where that is meaningful. Must be greater than zero.

institution.description: Where the asset is held or stored.

notes.description: Anything the user wants to remember about it.
notes.example: Tiền gửi dự phòng bằng USD.

symbol.description: Ticker, ISIN or fund code, as the user types it. Nothing resolves it against a market. Accepted for LISTED_SECURITIES, BOND, INVESTMENT_FUND and OTHER_ASSET; any other category refuses it.

costPerUnit.description: What one unit cost, in this asset's own currency. Entered by the user and never multiplied by the quantity. Accepted for the same four categories as the symbol.

currentPricePerUnit.description: What one unit is worth now, in this asset's own currency. Entered by the user; currentValue is a separate field and is never derived from this one. Accepted for the same four categories as the symbol.

interestRate.description: Interest rate or expected yield as a percent per year, so 6.2500 is 6.25%. No interest is accrued and no yield projected from it. Accepted for BOND, TERM_DEPOSIT and OTHER_ASSET only: a listed security has no rate, and a fund's expected return belongs in the notes.

X-Correlation-Id.description: Correlation identifier. Send one matching ^[A-Za-z0-9-]{8,64}$ to have it echoed; anything else is replaced with a generated value and the request still succeeds. Always returned.

bearerAuth.description: The access token returned by /api/v1/auth/google or /api/v1/auth/refresh. Short-lived; renew with the refresh token rather than waiting for a 401.
